service.name: cfactory
service.title: CFactory
service.description: The control tower. CFactory threads each unit of work across PFactory -> AIFactory -> TFactory using a WorkItem correlation store keyed by the RFC-0001 correlation key, ingesting completion events on a webhook and streaming the cockpit over WebSocket. It is a pure consumer: it observes the other services and only writes through copilot actions, which are prepared first and executed only on human confirmation.

skills.name: workitems-list
skills.description: List work items, optionally filtered by project or status. A work item is one unit of work threaded across the whole fleet, so this is the fastest way for an agent to see everything currently in flight.

skills.name: workitem-get
skills.description: Fetch the aggregated state of one work item across all four services by its RFC-0001 correlation key: where the plan, the build and the verification each stand, in one object.

skills.name: workitem-timeline
skills.description: Get the ordered completion events for one work item - the audit trail of what each service did and when. Use it to answer 'why is this stuck' without opening four portals.

skills.name: usage-aggregate
skills.description: Aggregate token and cost usage by service, project or work item. Metered providers report currency; subscription and local providers report tokens and time.

skills.name: copilot-advise
skills.description: Prepare - but do not execute - an action against a work item, such as a rerun or a handback. Returns a prepared action describing exactly what would happen. This is the only way CFactory writes anything, and it is deliberately a two-step.

skills.name: copilot-confirm
skills.description: Execute a previously prepared copilot action. Requires the action id from copilot-advise and represents the human-in-the-loop confirmation step; nothing mutates without it.
